placements.title: Authority Commands the System to Forget
placements.frame: What does it reveal when authority unilaterally directs the erasure of specific knowledge domains — and what conditions trigger forgetting as a deliberate act?
placements.why: Both segments are bare imperatives issued by Xena ExpertGH commanding comprehensive removal of specific knowledge — the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts in src-1, zeppelin routes in src-2. The thematic content is the act of authority directing knowledge erasure: a subject future envelopes could continue to feed as similar directives or erasure events arise. No existing graph structure or strata holds this theme, so it must be minted. The grain test passes: this names a recurring subject (directed forgetting), not a one-time fact.
